updates.label: When there are too many tabs to fit, '...' elide their names so they fit:
updates.assessment: The page tab names checkbox stages/persists/imports/reopens with default true. The actual native tab label uses measured glyph widths and per-input fitting state to paint a middle ellipsis only when overflow requires it; the stored/decorated label and full tooltip remain unchanged. Disabled elision keeps complete label text in the scrolling strip; small overflow arrows preserve label height and reserve a trailing area so the final tab can be exposed at maximum scroll. Both horizontal and vertical bars consume the flag, including nested notebooks.
